# Read the score data (rows 2-8, columns B-G)

scores = []
for row in range(2, 9):
    name = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    player_scores = [ws.cell(row=row, column=c).value for c in range(2, 8)]  # B through G
    players.append(name)
    scores.append(player_scores)

num_players = 7

    col_scores = [scores[p][g] for p in range(num_players)]
    max_score = max(col_scores)
